options.metric: average crashes per occurrence of weekday = crashes dated on that weekday divided by the number of calendar dates of that weekday in 2013-2025
options.denominator: the actual count of Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday dates in the complete calendar-year span 2013-2025, respectively
options.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, ordered Monday through Sunday
options.chart_type: bar chart of average crashes per calendar occurrence of each weekday
options.reason: Dividing each weekday's total by its number of calendar occurrences adjusts the comparison for the small differences in how often weekdays occur in the 13-year period.
options.answer: The average was highest on Friday at 499.7 police-reported crashes per calendar Friday and lowest on Sunday at 379.9 per calendar Sunday.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the weekday distribution as the average number of police-reported crashes per calendar occurrence of each weekday, counting one crash per row by its crash_date weekday over 2013-2025 inclusive; weekday denominators range from 678 to 679 dates.
